meta.name: add-linear
meta.description: Add Linear channel integration via Chat SDK. Issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Linear 问题评论同步成聊天对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想把 Linear 的讨论直接搬到聊天里。
copy.tagline_en: Sync Linear issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Linear discussions to land directly in chat.

howto.what: 把 Linear 接入工作区后,Claude 会参与你所选团队中每个 issue 的评论线程:任意一条评论都会触发它回复,不需要 @。每个 issue 的评论线程是各自独立的会话。
howto.when: 当你把某个 Linear 团队的 issue 评论接入后,该团队 issue 下的任意评论都会触发它,无需 @ 提及。只对配置的那一个团队生效。

say.text: 帮我把 Linear 频道接进项目,团队 Key 用 ENG
say.note: Claude 会执行安装步骤,再向你索要凭证

say.text: 改用 Personal API Key 方式配置 Linear
say.note: 机器人以你的身份发言,你自己的评论会被过滤

say.text: 我的 Linear issue 评论没反应,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查 webhook 配置和注册测试

howto.what_en: With Linear wired in, Claude takes part in every comment thread of an issue in the team you pick. Any comment triggers it — no @-mention needed. Each issue thread is its own isolated conversation.
howto.when_en: Once a Linear team is wired up, any comment on that team's issues triggers Claude, with no @-mention required. Only the single team you configure routes to it.

say_en.text: Add the Linear channel to my project, team key ENG
say_en.note: Claude runs the Apply steps, then asks for credentials

say_en.text: Set up Linear with a Personal API key instead
say_en.note: Bot posts as you; your own comments get filtered

say_en.text: My Linear issue comments never reach the agent
say_en.note: Claude checks the webhook and registration test
